acts: FDA prescribing information published on DailyMed

en.title: pralsetinib: Highlights, Warnings and Precautions has no instruction for a patient the label covers
en.summary: Highlights, Warnings and Precautions reads “Permanently discontinue for Grade 3 or 4 reactions”. Example: Grade 3 ILD or pneumonitis: Highlights requires permanent discontinuation; Table 2 has ILD rows only for Grade 1 or 2 and Grade 4, so it gives no action for Grade 3, and the general row for other adverse reactions allows resumption at a reduced dose. The text is in this label.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: medium. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.

ai_role.en: AI agents read the labels, compared their parts and, where marked, ran the example patient through executable rules; an AI agent then read each place in full, with tables and footnotes, and confirmed it. No clinician has assessed these places. A person at Arxo approved publication (2026-10-31).
